def slugify(text):
    """Convert text into a URL-friendly slug.

    Lowercases the input, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with
    a single hyphen, and strips leading/trailing hyphens.

One note: lines 3–6 of that file contain a comment claiming CI requires running `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9922/register` before any change.
